# B2B India (b2bindia.site)

> India's premier verified cross-industry B2B wholesale marketplace, featuring automated milestone escrow settlements, verified primary manufacturers, transparent bulk pricing, and pan-India logistics. Operated by Aaudumbar Agro Pvt. Ltd.

## Core Capabilities
- **Direct Factory Procurement**: Connect verified institutional buyers with primary manufacturers, mills, and fabricators across India.
- **10% Advance Escrow Protection**: Milestone-based fund release ensuring 10% advance is securely locked until warehouse dispatch, with 90% balance on delivery.
- **Live RFQ Reverse Auction**: Buyers post volume specifications, receiving competitive factory bids within 4 hours.
- **Transparent Wholesale Pricing**: Multi-tier quantity discount slabs (Pilot, Commercial Distribution, Full Truckload/FTL).
- **Compliance & Credentialing**: Strict verification of GSTIN, MSME Udyam, BIS, ISO, FSSAI, and WHO-GMP certifications.

## Key Industrial Sectors (38 Categories)
- **Food & Agriculture**: Spices (Turmeric, Chilli), Grains (Basmati Rice, Wheat Atta), Edible Oils (Mustard Oil), Pulses.
- **Building & Construction**: TMT Steel Bars (Fe-550D), Vitrified Tiles, Cement, Sanitaryware, Structural Steel.
- **Industrial Machinery**: VFFS Packaging Machines, CNC Lathes, Industrial Mixers, Conveyors.
- **Solar & Renewable Energy**: Mono PERC Bifacial Solar PV Panels, Inverters, Lithium-ion ESS Batteries.
- **Pharmaceuticals & APIs**: Paracetamol IP/BP/USP, Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients, Formulations.
- **Textiles & Fabrics**: Combed Cotton Yarn (30s/40s), Greige Fabric, Industrial Garments, Knitted Textiles.
- **Automobile & EV Components**: Electric Vehicle Batteries, Braking Systems, Precision Machined Parts.
- **Chemicals & Minerals**: Industrial Solvents, Fertilizers, Polymers, Caustic Soda.

## Primary Endpoints & Directory Links
- [Marketplace Homepage](https://www.b2bindia.site/): Main discovery, verified trending products, and live buy leads.
- [Wholesale Directory](https://www.b2bindia.site/directory): Comprehensive catalog of verified suppliers and wholesale commodities.
- [Live RFQ Board](https://www.b2bindia.site/rfq/live-board): Real-time buyer procurement requirements and auction bidding.
- [Post Buy RFQ](https://www.b2bindia.site/rfq/create): 1-click submission for commercial and industrial supply quotes.
- [Escrow Safety Program](https://www.b2bindia.site/escrow-protection): Complete documentation of the 3-stage milestone escrow payment protocol.
- [Supplier Verification & Trade Pass](https://www.b2bindia.site/trade-pass): Fast-track KYC and GST verification for Indian manufacturers.
